summary: Fase 1b · Pricing cascade UI validated end-to-end on preview. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) Settings tab consolidation, (2) engine save & persistence, (3) sell_price/min_margin removed from Basic tab, (4) sell_price/min_margin present in Costing tab + Manual badge shown when sell_price>0, (5) PlatedMenuBuilder menu-price-source-badge + 'referencia' chip + formula '= cost ÷ (1 − margin)', (6) backend POST /api/pricing/resolve returns full payload for recipe_id and menu_id. Existing pytest suite test_pricing_cascades.py still 8/8 green. No regressions detected.
